title: Scenario E - governance or oracle change, then a depeg
description: Market parameters change first (liquidation threshold shift, oracle switch), then the scenario A shock. comparison: same depeg on today's parameters.

usde_spot_shock_pct.description: Signed move of the USDe market price, e.g. -0.05.

susde_market_beta.description: sUSDe market move = beta x USDe move.

backing_impairment_pct.description: USDe backing loss, repriced by the market for USDe and sUSDe. Signed, 0 = none. An exchange-rate oracle with USDe hardcoded at 1 USD does not see it.

susde_rate_cut_pct.description: Optional. Loss socialised to sUSDe stakers: the sUSDe exchange rate falls. Every sUSDe oracle sees it. Signed, default 0.

oracle_lag_hours.description: Reported for timing; final metrics use the fully passed-through oracle.

pt_implied_apy_shock.description: Additive change of PT implied APY.

liquidation_threshold_shift.description: Signed shift of the liquidation threshold (Aave LT, Morpho LLTV), e.g. -0.05.

oracle_switch_pass_through.description: New oracle pass-through after the switch (1 = market price feed); null = no switch.

target_markets.description: Position ids whose market changes; null = every lending market.
